summary: Stanley Black & Decker filed an 8-K reporting entry into a 364-Day Credit Agreement, a $1.0 billion revolving credit facility with Citibank as administrative agent and several lead arrangers. Borrowings bear interest at Base Rate, EURIBO, or Term SOFR plus applicable margin, with a final maturity of June 17, 2027, convertible into a one-year term loan. This is a routine refinancing/credit facility arrangement, not a special situation. There is no change of control, premium, or strategic event; the filing simply establishes ordinary financing terms.
